name: manette-produit
description: Page produit MANETTE — bundle JSX via esbuild, GLB compresse via gltf-transform.

scripts.build:glb: gltf-transform resize assets/manette-source.glb assets/_tmp.glb --width=512 --height=512 && gltf-transform draco assets/_tmp.glb assets/manette.glb --quantize-position 14 --quantize-normal 10 --quantize-color 8 --quantize-texcoord 12 && node -e "require('fs').unlinkSync('assets/_tmp.glb')"
